name: Track Format 1 Code
definition: Use to identify format of a track on a card or other documents like checks.

CMC7.name: CMC 7 Check Format
CMC7.definition: Magnetic Ink Character Recognition, using the CMC-7 font - ISO 1004 Line at the bottom of a check containing the bank account and the check number.

E13B.name: E 13 B Check Format
E13B.definition: Magnetic Ink Character Recognition, using the E-13B font) Line at the bottom of a check containing the bank account and the check number.

ISOF.name: ISO Format
ISOF.definition: ISO card track format - ISO 7813 - ISO 4909.
